name: Boadilla del Camino (Spain)
description: Red field with a white stripe along the hoist bearing two outlined scallop shells, charged at the centre with a yellow Gothic pillory column.
history: Municipal flag of Boadilla del Camino; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: two scallop shells outlined on the white stripe
Gothic pillory column (rollo) at the centre
